prompt: Given the collection of intervals `intervals = [[1, 4], [2, 3], [5, 8], [6, 9], [11, 14]]`, all overlapping intervals are merged together. How many non-overlapping intervals remain after merging?
explanation: Sorting by start times and collapsing overlapping ranges gives [[1, 4], [5, 9], [11, 14]], which contains exactly 3 non-overlapping interval(s).
